friction.summary: LoanBrokerSet only creates: resubmitting for the same VaultID silently creates a second broker (1 created, 0 modified) and LoanBrokerID is rejected temINVALID, so broker terms are immutable with no documented way to tell.

Broker owner must be the vault owner, and only that account can attach the LoanSet CounterpartySignature (CPT prefix, not exposed by browser wallets) or deposit cover (non-owner gets tecNO_PERMISSION), so a wallet-owned vault can never originate a loan from a web app.
A gated deposit returns tecNO_AUTH identically for a missing credential, an unaccepted credential, and one from an issuer the domain does not trust; three probes were needed to isolate the cause.
WithdrawalPolicy: 0 is malformed rather than defaulted (the enum starts at 1) and the error names no field.
No index from a vault to its broker and no way to enumerate lending markets; a directory required joining account_objects type=vault with type=loan_broker per owner on VaultID.

doc_questions.question: What does tecNO_AUTH mean on a vault deposit, and which of the possible causes applies?
How do you change a loan broker's terms after the vault is created, or are they immutable?
How do you discover lending markets, given there is no vault-to-broker index?

error_codes.actual_mistake: WithdrawalPolicy set to 0; valid values start at 1 and the error names no field
Passed LoanBrokerID to update an existing broker; updating is unsupported
Credential missing, unaccepted, or issued by an account the domain does not trust
Non-owner tried to fund first-loss cover

abandoned.what: Editing broker terms (management fee, minimum cover) after vault creation
abandoned.blocked_at: LoanBrokerSet resubmission creates a duplicate broker; LoanBrokerID rejected temINVALID

workarounds.what: Server-held desk account owns the vault and broker so loans can be co-signed, while the creator funds cover via a payment the server verifies before depositing
Market discovery by joining account_objects type=vault and type=loan_broker on VaultID
Repointing a permissioned domain's accepted issuer to repair vaults gated to the wrong account

single_fix: Make LoanBrokerSet update an existing broker in place (or reject a duplicate outright and document that terms are immutable); silently creating a second broker for the same vault can orphan one holding first-loss cover.
not_observed: Whether broker terms can be changed by any mechanism; only LoanBrokerSet was tried, with and without LoanBrokerID.
Whether ledger-wide vault enumeration via ledger_data type=vault is practical; only per-owner enumeration was measured.
Whether any specific browser wallet adapter can produce a CPT-prefixed counterparty signature; inferred from the signing scheme, not tested per adapter.
Whether the developer used other Claude sessions or tools during the period (checkpoint mode does not ask).
